_what: External secret providers a request may point at (computer/secret-references.mjs). A reference is the text `secret://<provider>/<path>`. A provider is a row in `providers`: `kind` command (run `argv`, the secret is its standard output) or http (GET `url`, the secret is read from the JSON answer at `extract`). `{path}` in argv, url or a header is filled with the reference path; `{env:NAME}` is filled from the named environment variable of this process and the request is refused when it is missing. `cache_ms` is how long a resolved value is kept in memory only (never written anywhere). A new provider is a new row; the list ships empty.

words.unknown_provider: There is no secret provider named {provider}.
words.bad_reference: {reference} is not a secret reference like secret://provider/path.
words.missing_env: The provider {provider} needs the environment variable {name}, which is not set.
words.failed: The provider {provider} could not give the secret.
words.empty: The provider {provider} gave nothing for that reference.
